_meta.purpose: Hand-owned per-name decisions. The ONLY file in this repo that is never written by anything in tools/ -- edit it directly. Applied LAST, after every derived feed, so it always wins.
_meta.key: Bloomberg ticker, space form, matching ticker_master.json (e.g. 'SOFI US', 'IFX GY')

fields.analyst: Reassign coverage. Beats analyst_map.json and the Lightkeeper tag.
fields.mute: Never nudge, but keep the name in coverage and keep showing it in the summary. Use for 'stop bothering them about this for now'.
fields.retire: Drop from coverage entirely -- no nudge, no gap report. Use when the firm has stopped following the name.
fields.force: Nudge even when a guard would suppress (dormant coverage, unverifiable export). Use to override the script's judgement on one name.
fields.until: ISO date. The action lifts automatically on that date. Strongly preferred over an open-ended mute.
fields.pt_date: Assert the effective price-target date when both the CSV and the inbox have it wrong.
fields.status: Assert ticker status (live | acquired | private | renamed) without editing tools/gen_ticker_master.py.
fields.reason: REQUIRED. In four months an entry with no reason is indistinguishable from a mistake.
fields.date: When the call was made. Used to flag entries for review.

rules: Every entry needs a reason. The script warns on any that lack one.
Entries with an 'until' lift themselves on that date and are reported when they do.
Entries with no 'until' are flagged for review after override_review_days (90).
Every active override is listed in the weekly summary email. A mute nobody remembers is how something real goes missing.

reassign.reason: LK only carries the PM tag

retire.reason: firm no longer follows the name

assert a date.reason: submitted but not yet posted or emailed

force through a guard.reason: want this one despite no position

SOFI US.reason: James's name. Lightkeeper only carries the PM (DM) tag, so the generated map leaves it unowned.
